title: Paper Maze · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paper Maze · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Give the lead paper and pencil and choose a starting point and finish. The lead draws a simple maze with one continuous route from start to finish. A partner traces the intended route with a pencil without crossing a wall. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paper Maze, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
A partner traces the intended route with a pencil without crossing a wall.
recall.why: A partner traces the intended route with a pencil without crossing a wall.
